The HTML examples and CSS are frozen visual reference fixtures extracted from
user-provided card snippets and the visual styles in the supplied HAR. They are
independent of the production renderer and are not regenerated by the tests.

Native layout: 360px wide, 1.25 scale, light Betano theme, 14px root font size.
Team logo images are removed as in the site's original export. The first 338 rows
of the 450px-wide native card are compared with the downloaded PNG.

The test renders these references natively in the same browser/OS that runs the
export. This keeps operating-system font hinting out of the comparison while
checking actual SVG export fidelity to the original HTML/CSS, with tight pixel
tolerances. font.sha256 preserves the original HAR font's identity.

Only the user-provided public example teams, markets and odds are present. The
HAR, account API responses, request headers and other browsing resources are
excluded. These fixtures are used only by tests and are not published to Pages.

original-live.html uses the existing public basketball example with manual sample
scores and clock. Its scoreboard structure and styles follow the public Vue
component and CSS in the live HAR; the lightning icon is a local vector.

The two first-half references use the new user-provided point and handicap
examples. The Phoenix Suns and San Antonio Spurs badge data comes unchanged
from image resources in the earlier HAR, embedded locally as data URLs.
